[[File:Sylvester EP145.png|thumb|250px|Sylvester]] '''Sylvester''' (Japanese: '''ナオト''' ''Naoto'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP145|A Farfetch'd Tale]]''. He and his boss [[Yosaku]] (father in the English dub) live in the [[Ilex Forest]]. They cut down trees and use them to make [[Charcoal]]. Sylvester tried to use his {{p|Farfetch'd}} and its {{m|Cut}} attack to cut down a tree, but it wouldn't listen to him. {{Ash}} told him that this was because he commanded it to use ''Cutting Attack'', rather than Cut. After it was stolen by {{TRT}}, Sylvester helped save Farfetch'd. Realizing that its Trainer cared about it, Farfetch'd began to listen and helped Sylvester cut down trees for Charcoal. As a way of expressing his thanks, Sylvester and his father gave Ash and his friends some Charcoal. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|1|java|scope=section}} This listing is of Sylvester's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Sylvester |pkmn=Farfetch'd |type1=Normal |type2=Flying |img=Sylvester Farfetch'd.png |epnum=EP145 |epname=A Farfetch'd Tale |vaen=Maddie Blaustein{{!}}Maddie Blaustein |desc={{p|Farfetch'd}} refused to listen to Sylvester initially because of his inexperience. Sylvester wanted to use it to slice trees and make [[Charcoal]] but it later ran away. {{TRT}} then found it, wandering, and cornered it. It tried to run away and flew up to a tree. [[Jessie]] sent out her {{TP|Jessie|Lickitung}} and it stole its leek, however. It tried to escape again, but this time it was successfully captured by Team Rocket. [[Ash's Heracross]] spotted it and the gang came to its rescue. {{Ash}}'s Pokémon broke the net, but Lickitung quickly captured Farfetch'd with its tongue. After a long battle, Sylvester was able to grab Farfetch'd's leek from Jessie, and was able to command it successfully now, sending Team Rocket blasting off. Later, it was able to slice a tree correctly, much to [[Yosaku]]'s satisfaction. Farfetch'd's known moves are {{m|Cut}}, {{m|Peck}}, and {{m|Fury Attack}}.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{normal color}}|bordercolor={{normal color light}} |ja=吉野裕行 ''Hiroyuki Yoshino'' |en=[[Amy Birnbaum]] |ar=إيمان بيطار ''Iman Bitar'' |fr_eu=Baptiste Hupin |he=יפה גבאי ''Yafa Gabay'' |it=Marcella Silvestri (Mediaset)
